==Idle Quotes==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''KU-Clinic:''' How many moons are there in the sky?
:'''Amamiya:''' One... Can you stop asking me these weird questions? My head hurts...
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Is water toxic or non-toxic?
:'''Amamiya:''' Are you serious? Non-toxic.
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Is the [[Shorekeeper]] male or female?
:'''Amamiya:''' How am I supposed to know? I've never met them before!
{{Dialogue End}}

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Amamiya:''' W-wait a second... Is this person here real or simulated?
:{{DIcon}} Of course I'm real.
:{{DIcon}} Yeah, I'm totally fake.
::'''Amamiya:''' Ahhhhh!
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Don't worry, (he's/she's) real.
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Your treatment isn't finished yet. Please stay still.
:{{DIcon}} What happened to him?
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Amamiya, field agent. The preliminary diagnosis is mild reality perception disorder. In other words, the patient may feel like their surroundings aren't real.
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Most of our members are experiencing this because the Tethys' reality Anchors are unstable.
:'''Amamiya:''' No wonder I've had a stomachache and headache ever since I got out of the underground area.
:'''KU-Clinic:''' Wait... Is this pain even real, or...?
:'''KU-Clinic:''' It's real, trust me.
:'''Amamiya:''' Darn it! I've only been to the [[Black Shores]] for a few days... Useless me!
{{Dialogue End}}
